identityReview: Lebanese-Canadian Shell executive Wael Sawan, Arabic وائل صوان. July 1974 birth supported by read Reuters factbox, not calculated from age. Corporate and university records support education and career identity; corporate headquarters location is not citizenship.
lifeStatusEvidence: The Kuwait Crown Prince Diwan records an actual audience with Sawan at Bayan Palace on 4 November 2026. The dated text was read and identifies him as Shell CEO; it is not a future event notice or an inference from an absent death date.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read company biography, relevant SEC appointment and annual-report passages, contemporaneous Qatar reporting, Reuters factboxes and strategy reporting, Shell strategy tables, university alumni entry and official Kuwaiti meeting record. Read Commons metadata and license text.
corrections: Read current Shell board biography: Lebanese and Canadian nationality, CEO since 1 January 2023, initial engineering role with Petroleum Development Oman, MEng and MBA. Its mid-2000s description of Qatar leadership conflicts with contemporaneous reporting; that date is not adopted. Generic corporate praise is not repeated as an independent assessment.

Read Reuters 15 September 2022 factbox: born in Beirut in July 1974, grew up in Dubai, chemical-engineering master’s. Birth precision remains month, not an invented day. Its November 2021 description of the gas role is superseded by the precise 25 October date in the annual report.

Read 17 January 2019 appointment filing: Upstream Director and Executive Committee membership effective 1 July 2019; Andy Brown leaves later. The OBE paragraph refers to Brown, not Sawan. Do not transfer that award or confuse Executive Committee membership with appointment to the corporate board.

Read original report published 20 May 2015, despite a 2022 update timestamp. It places Qatar work from 2008, top-role promotion in April 2012 and appointment to Deepwater in 2015. July 1 is Kool’s succession date; no unsupported precise Deepwater start day is assigned. Kool’s mining degree and career are not Sawan’s.

Read 2021 annual report, printed page 130: Sawan succeeded Wetselaar on 25 October 2021 as Integrated Gas, Renewables and Energy Solutions Director. Tenure from July 2019 concerns Executive Committee service, not continuous tenure in the gas role. Yujnovich’s biography is separate.
Read 15 September 2022 SEC announcement: CEO and board appointment effective 1 January 2023. Van Beurden’s later advisory period and June 2023 group departure are not treated as Sawan’s start date.

Read the 14 March 2024 strategy text and target tables. Net carbon intensity by 2030 has a 2016 baseline and 15–20% reduction target; 2035 45% target retired. The separate 15–20% ambition for customers’ use of oil products has a 2021 baseline. Neither is an already-achieved absolute emissions reduction.

Read Reuters 14 March 2024 report: prior intensity target was 20%; strategy emphasised higher returns, steady oil output and gas growth. Preserve the distinction between intensity and total emissions. These historical target revisions are not claimed to exhaust all strategy updates through 2026.

Read Kuwait Crown Prince Diwan’s dated account of the actual meeting on 4 November 2026 at Bayan Palace. It identifies Sawan as Shell CEO and discussion of economic cooperation. No specific contract or transaction completion is inferred.
Read McGill’s notable-alumni entry, which explicitly lists Sawan as MEng 1997. MBA supported by Shell filing; no unsupported MBA graduation year or engineering doctorate added.
sourceReview.limits: No full portrait or Flickr-origin inspection. T. Rowe Price interview audio/video was not inspected or used. A trade-publication appointment page failed to fetch and Yahoo Reuters copy returned 429; equivalent claims rely on readable primary filings and Reuters via MarketScreener. Historical 2024 targets are not presented as a complete inventory of current targets.

Capture listed as 2 February 2010; full original is listed as 3072×2048. Original request returned CONNECT 403 / HTTP 000 on 18 November 2026, and cache is absent. Flickr source-chain, identity, colour and crop inspection remain outstanding. Preserve attribution, license link and notice of changes if used.

translationReview.scope: 32 display fields in each of seven foreign languages checked against Chinese and the English reference. Preserve dual nationality, month-only birth precision, Executive Committee versus corporate board, announcement versus effective dates, and carbon intensity versus total emissions with the correct 2016 baseline.
